channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US strikes in Yemen killed 153 civilians in 2025, says Pentagon review
item.description: The unclassified Pentagon review sheds new light on civilian harm from the US campaign against Yemen’s Houthis.

item.title: Hegseth cautions that ICC may investigate US boat strikes in Latin America
item.description: US defence chief vows to continue campaign against drug cartels, says Colombia has joined regional military coalition.

item.title: Drone attacks on energy infrastructure deepen Libya’s energy crisis
item.description: Repeated drone strikes on oil and power infrastructure are deepening Libya's energy crisis.

item.title: Israeli air strike kills one in northern Gaza
item.description: Strike on a tuk-tuk in Beit Lahiya kills one, wounds five in first Israeli aerial bombardment in a week

item.title: Deadly India landslide kills at least seven in Mumbai
item.description: Heavy rains triggered a landslide on Wednesday that killed at least seven people in India’s western Maharashtra state.

item.title: Israeli settlers besieging Palestinian families in West Bank village
item.description: Israeli security forces have reportedly withdrawn and about a dozen settlers are said to remain at the site where two families have been besieged since Sunday.

item.title: Members of Trump's cabinet remained on decoy plane, after president's quiet exit
item.description: Trump boarded a different plane in Turkey during a Nato summit for security reasons involving Iran.

item.title: In shattered Cali, residents search for loved ones and signs of hope
item.description: Most deaths from the magnitude-7.4 quake were reported in Cali, Colombia’s third-most populous city, as crews search collapsed buildings for those still trapped.

item.title: Watch: Why was Trump smuggled out of Air Force One in a catering truck?
item.description: US media reports say the president secretly left via a catering truck to avoid a threat to his life from Iran.
